name: prior-art
description: Study how the best already solved it, then copy what works. An always-on reuse-first convention steers Claude and its subagents to existing code, the standard library, installed dependencies, maintained libraries and official SDKs before they build their own, and has Claude check its code and plans against it before a turn ends. UI mode harvests reference interfaces (HTML, CSS, design tokens) from excellent brands into a gitignored .ref/ archive with a curated audit; research mode finds 3-5 strong implementations of anything else (architecture, hardware, best-known methods) and presents a copy-this recommendation before building.
